text:
Maya: Opening Celestis Labs POC thread. They need: Python streaming SDK demo -> Node later, function/tool-calls (data_normalizer) that return strict JSON for their ETL, SAML SSO, KMS for PHI-like fields, and a reserved capacity quote. Any volunteers for end-to-end?
Ibrahim: I can do SDK samples + a small validator harness. Will start with Python.
Leah P: I'll own security questionnaire items: KMS flow, key rotation, SOC2 docs, and DPA. Need an HSM/KMS diagram to show separation.
Omar: For SSO we have our SAML SP template. @Maya please upload their IdP metadata. Capacity: they expect 30 rps steady, spikes to 120. Perf target p50 < 220ms at baseline.
Maya: Uploaded IdP XML and an initial security draft to the drive (shared/celestis/poc).
PresalesBot: POC ticket POC-9998 created. Owners: Maya, Ibrahim. Due: 2026-04-15.
Ibrahim: Small Python streaming + tool-call example for the demo harness:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with c.streaming.generate(model="rw-small-quant", stream=True) as s:
    s.call_tool("data_normalizer", {"payload": doc})
    for e in s:
        # e.text expected to be JSON string matching contract
        print(e.text)
```
Maya: Good. Also provide a raw WebSocket example for their infra folks. Add schema validation so the demo fails visibly if output doesn't match.
Omar: I'll sketch a provisional Dedicated commit (rough baseline 1.2k GPU-hours/mo) and a fallback plan: Dedicated -> canary autoscale -> hosted small model. Will refine after perf numbers.
Leah P: Requesting SOC2 report, pen test summary, and DPA signature. I'll attach KMS separation diagram and key lifecycle doc to the ticket.
Ibrahim: Running a quick perf sweep on rw-small-quant with 2x batcher now. Will push p50/p95 and resource metrics to drive/tools/perf in ~35m.
Maya: Acceptance criteria for Celestis: 1) streaming demo with data_normalizer returns validated JSON; 2) perf p50 <220ms at 30 rps sustained; 3) SAML SSO tested end-to-end; 4) contract: DPA signed + SOC2 on file. Proposed demo: Wed 10am PT.
PresalesBot: Reminder: add billing contact to POC-9998 to generate formal estimate.
Omar: Posted provisional commit estimate to the drive; will update after Ibrahim uploads perf.
Leah P: Legal looped for DPA, attaching compliance artifacts shortly.
Ibrahim: Uploaded perf artifacts and sample payloads. Early numbers look promising — p50 ~ 170ms at 30 rps.
Maya: Awesome. I'll coordinate with the customer and schedule the demo once Legal confirms DPA. Thanks team :thumbsup:
